delegated_base_errors: Actual assembled_case_policy.create_policy and investigation_policy/component pure validators retain their original errors, no generic catch/relabel of valid downstream validation. Registry shape must be validated by actual base before comparing its identity; policy monitoring validity must be validated by actual base before relying on equality.

ordered_local_checks.when: outer input is not an ordinary dict or its exact keys are not policy,services
recursive ordinary JSON/string-key/finite/no-cycle check or independent canonical copy fails; check before canonicalization, base policy or setup
services is not an ordinary dict, its key set is not exact common-fields plus public_search_registry,api_timing,api_execution_planning, or its version differs from assembled_case_api_prechoice_v1
marker differs in exact closed keys or finite JSON values from declared hmmer_api_execution_planning_v1/execution.estimate/public.hmmer.search
any services handoff_unit/acquired_record_unit/monitoring_information_unit is not exact int/float finite>0; bool/nonfinite/overflow invalid; performed before base construction or setup
actual ApiTimingBinding.from_record rejects; preserve its existing ValueError contract
valid explicit API registry resource_id differs from timing resource_id
valid timing/service/policy/native information units differ; preserve actual shared-helper error token

postfactory_setup_errors: Actual assembled service/helper/planner/registry/owner/client errors propagate unchanged; no retry/fallback/adoption.
